accepted.sentence: Naval forces position these vessels near strategic chokepoints to threaten hostile shipping and constrain an adversary’s movement at sea.
Land-attack cruise missiles let some naval vessels strike inland targets from distant offshore launch positions.
Special operations teams use these vessels for concealed transport, disembarking near shore to conduct missions ashore.
Some protect carrier groups by helping detect and deter hostile underwater threats along the formation’s route.
Certain designs deploy unmanned underwater vehicles to inspect areas too hazardous or confined for the crewed craft.
Electronic intelligence missions monitor radar and radio emissions from nearby forces, revealing information about their activities.
During exercises, these vessels can act as adversaries, giving surface crews practice detecting and responding to underwater threats.
Military crews may patrol near critical undersea cables to watch for tampering and help protect communications infrastructure.
